title: Proposed Job-Matching System for Workers in Cleaning and Waste Management Industry
what_it_is: Proposed Job-Matching System for Workers in Cleaning and Waste Management Industry

sections.label: Industry-led job matching initiatives
sections.summary: Job-matching initiatives should be industry-led, and MOM would work with cleaning and waste management representatives on a sector-specific job facilitation proposal.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Job-matching initiatives should be initiated and led by the respective industries to ensure that they meet employers’ and workers’ hiring needs and are sustainable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Currently, most employers and workers work with existing employment agencies for their job matching needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: If the cleaning and waste management industry assesses that a sector-specific job facilitation system is necessary, MOM would be happy to work with the relevant industry representatives on their proposal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Which is that this could help to tackle this issue of power imbalance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I have seen first-hand that many migrant workers are very scared to report kickbacks, for example, because they are scared of losing their jobs and that the employer will send them back home.

sections.label: Reporting kickbacks to MOM
sections.summary: Workers who face kickbacks or victimisation should report to MOM so it can investigate and take employers to task.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: What we need to do is, if there are kickbacks being conducted, if the workers feel that they have been victimised, then they ought to report it to MOM so that we can do the necessary investigations and take employers to task.
